name: OTB lease evidence reconciliation

steps.description: Inventory files without changing originals; record paths, hashes, document date and access status.
Inspect relevant original pages, signature pages, amendments and incorporation/supersession language; preserve limits. OCR is an aid, not signature verification.
Match entity, suite aliases, physical units and lease group; retain uncertainty as an exception.
Compare contractual and operating fields separately as of an explicit date; retain every material competing value. A future rent step is not current billing.
Apply evidence and authority gates. Generate reviewable working files; stop before external communication or authoritative record changes unless separately permitted.
Validate draft registers and write an actual execution receipt with source locators, completed and failed work, exceptions and next action.

decision_nodes: Does the document establish the current term, or only a historic term?
Is rent contractual, adopted billing, or a future escalation?
Is a conflicting value materially unresolved?
Does the requested change have scoped active authority?
required_evidence: Every material field has a claim object
Current contractual term requires applicable governing instrument chain
Owner-adopted billing identifies the approval source and as-of date
authority_rules: A1 creates proposed working outputs only
A-level policy definitions are not grants
A4/A5 require human approval by default or a narrow written rule

approval_gates.trigger_condition: Current governing chain or material factual conflict remains unresolved
approval_gates.required_action: Retain alternatives and create/update an exception; do not declare the contractual fact verified.
approval_gates.fallback: Return proposed state with explicit unresolved scope

approval_gates.trigger_condition: Requested action exceeds scoped active authority
approval_gates.required_action: Stop that action and prepare the reviewable artifact.
approval_gates.fallback: Return blocked action and required approval
